title: AutoDriveTycoon — free browser idle game built almost entirely with generative AI (manual drive → robotaxi fleet)
author: tradebrosky
selftext:
Solo Quebec maker. Sharing a free browser idle game and the AI workflow behind it.

The game: AutoDriveTycoon, a free HTML idle game (mobile OK, no ads, no account). Drive manually, each km trains the car, unlock self-driving, then expand a robotaxi fleet on a world map. Optional purchases exist; not required to progress.

Play: https://autodrive-tycoon.felixsd.workers.dev/

How AI was used: an AI assistant wrote basically all of it — the single-file game code, art, UI text, translations into 10 languages, store copy and promo video. My role was the idea, directing what to build, playtesting and deciding what to fix.

What I'd love discussion on:
1. How you keep AI-generated game code maintainable in one HTML file.
2. Whether saying "mostly AI-built" helps or hurts players' interest in free browser games.
3. Early pacing: is a short manual-driving start before automation a good idle-game pattern?

Happy to answer process questions.

comments.author: beaglebug
comments.body: Enjoying it so far. I like the mobile UI, looks good on my iphone se. I will try on desktop tomorrow!
